            "lineNumber": 5

          {

          },

          {
            "text": "extern \"C\" __global__ void time_projection(",

          {
            "text": "extern \"C\" __global__ void render_commits(",

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "    if (idx &gt;= num_vertices) return;",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 356
          },
          {
            "text": "    GitCommitVertex vertex = vertices[idx];",

          },

            "lineNumber": 358
          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 361
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Apply camera transformation and projection",
            "lineNumber": 362
          },
          {
            "text": "    float3 view_pos = make_float3(",

          {
            "text": "        vertex.position[0] - params-&gt;camera_position[0],",

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 368
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Simple perspective projection",

          },
          {
            "text": "    float aspect = (float)width / (float)height;",

          },
          {
            "text": "    float fov = 3.14159f / 4.0f; // 45 degrees",

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "    if (view_pos.z &gt; 0.1f) {",

          },

            "lineNumber": 377
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Convert to pixel coordinates",
            "lineNumber": 378
          },
          {
            "text": "        int pixel_x = (int)((screen_x + 1.0f) * 0.5f * (float)width);",
            "lineNumber": 379
          },
          {
            "text": "        int pixel_y = (int)((1.0f - screen_y) * 0.5f * (float)height);",

          },

            "lineNumber": 381
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Check bounds",

          },
          {
            "text": "        if (pixel_x &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; pixel_x &lt; width &amp;&amp; pixel_y &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; pixel_y &lt; height) {",

          },
          {
            "text": "            // Convert RGBA to BGRA and pack into u32",

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "const GIT4D_KERNELS: &amp;str = r#\"",
            "lineNumber": 259
          },
          {
            "text": "extern \"C\" __global__ void vertex_transform(",
            "lineNumber": 260
          },
          {
            "text": "    const GitCommitVertex* vertices,",
            "lineNumber": 261
          },
          {
            "text": "    const float transform[4][4],",
            "lineNumber": 262
          },
          {
            "text": "    const RenderParameters* params,",
            "lineNumber": 263
          },
          {
            "text": "    GitCommitVertex* output,",
            "lineNumber": 264
          },
          {
            "text": "    unsigned int num_vertices",
            "lineNumber": 265
          },
          {
            "text": ") {",
            "lineNumber": 266
          },
          {
            "text": "    unsigned int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;",
            "lineNumber": 267
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (idx &gt;= num_vertices) return;",
            "lineNumber": 268
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 269
          },
          {
            "text": "    GitCommitVertex vertex = vertices[idx];",
            "lineNumber": 270
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 271
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Apply time filtering",
            "lineNumber": 272
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (vertex.time &lt; params-&gt;time_filter.x || vertex.time &gt; params-&gt;time_filter.y) {",
            "lineNumber": 273
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Mark as invisible by setting alpha to 0",
            "lineNumber": 274
          },
          {
            "text": "        vertex.color[3] = 0.0f;",
            "lineNumber": 275
          },
          {
            "text": "        output[idx] = vertex;",
            "lineNumber": 276
          },
          {
            "text": "        return;",
            "lineNumber": 277
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 278
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 279
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Apply branch filtering",
            "lineNumber": 280
          },
          {
            "text": "    bool branch_visible = params-&gt;branch_filter.size == 0;",
            "lineNumber": 281
          },
          {
            "text": "    for (unsigned int i = 0; i &lt; params-&gt;branch_filter.size; ++i) {",
            "lineNumber": 282
          },
          {
            "text": "        if (vertex.branch_id == params-&gt;branch_filter.data[i]) {",
            "lineNumber": 283
          },
          {
            "text": "            branch_visible = true;",
            "lineNumber": 284
          },
          {
            "text": "            break;",
            "lineNumber": 285
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 286
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 287
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 288
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (!branch_visible) {",
            "lineNumber": 289
          },
          {
            "text": "        vertex.color[3] = 0.0f;",
            "lineNumber": 290
          },
          {
            "text": "        output[idx] = vertex;",
            "lineNumber": 291
          },
          {
            "text": "        return;",
            "lineNumber": 292
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 293
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 294
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Apply 4x4 transformation matrix",
            "lineNumber": 295
          },
          {
            "text": "    float4 pos = make_float4(vertex.position[0], vertex.position[1], vertex.position[2], 1.0f);",
            "lineNumber": 296
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 297
          },
          {
            "text": "    float4 transformed;",
            "lineNumber": 298
          },
          {
            "text": "    transformed.x = transform[0][0] * pos.x + transform[0][1] * pos.y + transform[0][2] * pos.z + transform[0][3] * pos.w;",
            "lineNumber": 299
          },
          {
            "text": "    transformed.y = transform[1][0] * pos.x + transform[1][1] * pos.y + transform[1][2] * pos.z + transform[1][3] * pos.w;",
            "lineNumber": 300
          },
          {
            "text": "    transformed.z = transform[2][0] * pos.x + transform[2][1] * pos.y + transform[2][2] * pos.z + transform[2][3] * pos.w;",
            "lineNumber": 301
          },
          {
            "text": "    transformed.w = transform[3][0] * pos.x + transform[3][1] * pos.y + transform[3][2] * pos.z + transform[3][3] * pos.w;",
            "lineNumber": 302
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 303
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (transformed.w != 0.0f) {",
            "lineNumber": 304
          },
          {
            "text": "        transformed.x /= transformed.w;",
            "lineNumber": 305
          },
          {
            "text": "        transformed.y /= transformed.w;",
            "lineNumber": 306
          },
          {
            "text": "        transformed.z /= transformed.w;",
            "lineNumber": 307
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 308
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 309
          },
          {
            "text": "    vertex.position[0] = transformed.x;",
            "lineNumber": 310
          },
          {
            "text": "    vertex.position[1] = transformed.y;",
            "lineNumber": 311
          },
          {
            "text": "    vertex.position[2] = transformed.z;",
            "lineNumber": 312
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 313
          },
          {
            "text": "    output[idx] = vertex;",
            "lineNumber": 314
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 315
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 316
          },
          {
            "text": "extern \"C\" __global__ void time_projection(",
            "lineNumber": 317
          },
          {
            "text": "    const GitCommitVertex* vertices,",

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "    float3* output_positions,",
            "lineNumber": 321
          },
          {
            "text": "    unsigned int num_vertices",
            "lineNumber": 322
          },
          {
            "text": ") {",
            "lineNumber": 323
          },
          {
            "text": "    unsigned int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;",
            "lineNumber": 324
          },
          {

          {

          },
          {
